alert.title: Alert
alert.description: A custom user alert for cryptocurrency price threshold

id.description: The unique ID of the alert

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the alert creator

symbol.description: The cryptocurrency trading pair, e.g. BTCUSDT

condition.description: Whether to trigger ABOVE or BELOW

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp of creation

triggered.description: Whether the alert has been triggered
